descriptive: Computes the orbit of the Aizawa system and shows it is a rotation at constant rate d with a radius driven by dr/dt = (z-b) r. TO: the orbit, the exact cylindrical rates, the fixed points on the axis with eigenvalues, and the Lyapunov exponent.
